Prepared by Timber Pricing Branch, Ministry of Forests, Lands, Natural Resource Operations and Rural Development
Note (1) The old growth reported is a blend of old and mixed growth log market transactions values, in accordance with ministry policy. Reference Coast Prices Information Paper:
Calculation of Coast Log Prices (gov.bc.ca). For the one-month data set, the average market value (AMV) for pure old growth is 140.93 $/m3 and for mixed growth 131.03 $/m3.
The volume of pure old growth reported is 15167.509 m3 and for mixed growth is 26611.392 m3.
Note (2) Three month totals may not equal the sum of previously published one month totals due to late or revised. Data is adjusted for Section 136 of the Forest Act.
Note (3) April 2023, new and additional participants to the Vancouver Log Market data set.
